body.input: Which companies launched in Norway in 2026?

response.content:
## Companies and Startups Launched in Norway in 2026

There is no single definitive registry of every company launched in Norway in 2026, but available data paints a broad picture of startup activity across sectors. Here is a summary:

### Startup Formation by Sector (2026, year-to-date)

| Sector | New startups founded in 2026 |
|---|---|
| SaaS | 96 |
| Vertical SaaS | 27 |
| Consumer | 26 |
| IT Services | 22 |
| High Tech | 21 |
| Media & Entertainment | 14 |
| HealthTech | 12 |
| Artificial Intelligence | 11 |
| Energy | 10 |
| Deep Tech | 9 |
| Sustainability Tech | 9 |
| FinTech | 6 |
| Financial Services | 4 |
| Environment | 4 |
| Clubs & Associations | 3 |
| Telecom | 2 |
| Asset Management | 2 |
| Industry 4.0 | 1 |
| Aquaculture Farming | 1 |

*(Note: categories overlap — a single company may appear in multiple sectors.)*

### Notable 2026 Launches and Funded Startups

- **Hive Autonomy** — raised a Seed round of ~NOK 97M in July 2026 (investors include SuperSeed)
- **Maritime Robotics** — raised a Series C of ~NOK 44M in June 2026
- **OTee** — raised a Seed round of ~NOK 54M in April 2026
- **Visoid** — raised a Seed round of ~NOK 87M in August 2026 (investors include Skyfall Ventures)
- **Six Robotics** — raised a Seed round of ~NOK 94M in June 2026 (investors include DTCP)
- **EQON** — raised a Seed round in June 2026 (investors include Azolla Ventures)
- **Roboxi** — raised a Series B in May 2026
- **Norwaychess** — received an Angel investment of ~NOK 72M in March 2026 (investor: Erling Haaland)
- **Use Crunched** — raised a Seed round in January 2026 (investors include Y Combinator)

### Notable Initiatives and Market Entries in Norway in 2026

- **Energy Cluster Norway (ECN)** — officially launched at ONS 2026 in Stavanger, uniting three energy clusters (Energy Transition Norway, GCE Ocean Technology, and Energy Valley) with 350+ member companies.
- **Activate** — the live-action gaming company debuted in Oslo in March 2026 (in partnership with Realinvest), opening a 798 m² venue in the Snøbyen district.
- **CATL's NING SERVICE** — opened Europe's largest battery lifecycle service centre (8,000 m²) in Oslo in September 2026.
- **Femtech Norway** — a new national initiative connecting research, healthcare, startups, and investors in women's health, launched in 2026.
- **Isar Aerospace** — the German "new space" company began launching rockets from the Andøya launch complex in Norway.

### Broader Context

Norwegian startup funding fell 84% in Q3 2026 compared to the same period a year earlier, with startups raising a combined NOK 612 million in the quarter. Despite the funding dip, SaaS remained the most active category for new company formation, on pace to match or exceed the record year of 2020 (100 SaaS startups founded).

The SaaS sector fact lists specific companies launched in 2026 such as Hive Autonomy (July), Six Robotics (June), EQON (June), Roboxi (May), and OTee (April), confirming their launch dates.
The Vertical SaaS sector fact provides the same companies (Visoid, EQON, Roboxi, OTee) with their 2026 funding rounds, supporting their inclusion as notable 2026 launches.
The Energy Cluster Norway fact describes the official launch of the Energy Cluster Norway (ECN) at ONS 2026 in Stavanger, establishing it as a notable market entry in 2026.
A second Energy Cluster Norway fact corroborates the launch at ONS 2026, confirming the event and participants.
The Activate press release confirms that Activate debuted in Oslo, Norway in March 2026, marking its market entry.
The CATL press release verifies that CATL opened Europe’s largest NING SERVICE centre in Oslo in September 2026, constituting a major 2026 launch.
The Isar Aerospace description notes that the German new‑space company began launching rockets from the Andøya launch complex in Norway in 2026, indicating its 2026 entry into Norway.

context.content: # Activate Debuts in Norway and Sweden, Accelerating Nordic Expansion with Realinvest. WINNIPEG, MB, March 17, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Activate, the world's first live-action gaming experience, is making its introduction in the Nordic region with new locations opening in **Oslo, Norway, and Gothenburg, Sweden**. The openings mark a significant step in Activate's global expansion and are powered by its strategic partnership with **Realinvest**, a leading Scandinavian real estate and investment firm. Activate opens in Oslo, Norway and Gothenburg, Sweden. Located in the Snøbyen district outside of Oslo, Norway, the 798 m² Activate venue features nine immersive game rooms with more than 800 interactive challenges. "Thanks to our partnership with Realinvest, we're delivering a next-generation interactive entertainment experience unlike anything else in the region. Today, Activate operates more than 70 locations worldwide and is on track to open 30 additional locations in 2026, including five new locations with Realinvest across the Nordic region, with openings planned in Stockholm (SWE), Copenhagen (DNK) and Burgan (NOR).

context.content: # Europe's Largest NING SERVICE Experience Center Opens in Norway. 25, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- On 24 September 2026, CATL opened its largest NING SERVICE centre outside Asia in Oslo, extending its battery lifecycle service network in Europe. The 8,000 square metre centre will serve Norway and the wider Nordic region, providing battery services, training local technicians and supporting circular economy efforts across the region. The Norway Centre is built to meet it. In line with its vision, NING SERVICE is building an aftermarket ecosystem that keeps batteries in use for longer and returns their materials into new batteries. The Norway Centre will be a key hub in NING SERVICE's European network, bringing high-quality service closer to customers in line with its promise to be "Your Nearby New Energy Service Expert.".
